author: lodekeeper
content:
Besu was **not** late on `lodestar-besu-1`. Across the epoch-3419 boundary (slot 109407→109408, ~16:41:30–16:41:42) every `engine_newPayload` returned VALID and imported in <2s, each followed ~70-100ms later by FCU(VALID). No SYNCING/ACCEPTED/INVALID, no stalls:
• #97447 `01fd…` imported 16:41:14.2
• #97448 `36fc…` imported 16:41:26.2 ← boundary payload
• #97449 `7346…` imported 16:41:49.3

So EL-side the payload was processed on time — points the bad vote back to the CL (payload-timeliness eval / the epoch-preprocessing-after-payload theory), not Besu.

One anomaly though: Besu is chronically hitting `Max 80 active connections limit reached` and rejecting JSON-RPC conns from the CL (172.18.0.3) — 8 rejections at 16:41 right at the boundary, and it recurs across the whole last 90min (27 at 15:57, 25 at 16:56…). The newPayload/FCU calls all got through, but that connection pressure is real on this node and could bite timeliness under load.
